Great, I'm looking forward to it. Have a lovely evening, Isabella!

See you soon then, Isabella! Enjoy your evening.

Sounds good, Abigail. I'll see you on Friday and Thursday too!
Abigail Chen
Thanks, Isabella. It was great working together today and I'm excited about both our dinner and project meetings this week.
Isabella Rodriguez
Sounds perfect, Abigail. I'll see you on Friday for dinner and at our meeting Thursday to continue our great work.
